note: Catalogue records, passage indexes and the exact reviewed segments for the Sanskrit texts GRETIL publishes. The reader still streams each work from GRETIL; the cache is an import and search-index artifact, not a second public copy. Each e-text's own header records the scholar who input it, the edition followed and the licence.
